🌟 Dogecoin Expands to Solana via NTT

$3.5 billion worth of Dogecoin bridged to Solana using Wormhole’s new NTT framework

NTT issues assets as native tokens, not wrapped tokens

Marks a new era for multichain expansion and growth of the Dogecoin ecosystem
